user.title: Smartmi P1 Extras
user.description: Connect directly to the P1 over your LAN. The local key is stored only in Home Assistant. Optionally select the existing Smartmi HomeKit device to suggest its area. Extras appear as a separate device.

reconfigure.title: Smartmi P1 Extras
reconfigure.description: Connect directly to the P1 over your LAN. The local key is stored only in Home Assistant. Optionally select the existing Smartmi HomeKit device to suggest its area. Extras appear as a separate device.

error.cannot_connect: No valid local response. Check the IP, local key and protocol version; close Smart Life and other local Tuya clients.
error.invalid_key: The local key must be exactly 16 UTF-8 bytes.
error.invalid_device: Select the existing Smartmi device from HomeKit Device.
error.unsupported_device: The device does not report any known supplemental P1 datapoints.
error.missing_connection_data: Enter a host and device ID.
